name: Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye
role: Personnel recovery and hostile extraction — extraction specialist
location: The Narrows — cramped residential corridors between megastructures, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 45, his face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and he has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on s — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, he worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. He works as a extraction specialist out of The Narrows, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "We go in, we get the asset, we leave. Everything else is improvisation."
"The extraction window is four minutes. I've done it in three."
"I don't rescue people. I relocate them aggressively."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: As a extraction specialist, Deniz Dahlberg-Boakye embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs. Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with efficient musculature — the physique of someone who converts nervous energy into controlled motion. Synthetic muscle fiber in legs creates subtle asymmetries in calf definition.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Short, pragmatic cut — minimal maintenance, pulled back slightly at crown
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive complexion with the pallor of someone who spends irregular hours indoors
physical_description.complexion: Sharp features — prominent cheekbones, angular jaw. Weathered around the eyes from sustained focus work. Five o'clock shadow is his default state. No visible facial scars but the skin has a tightness suggesting old impact trauma healed cleanly.
distinguishing_marks: Cigarette burn scar on the inside of left wrist — thumb-sized, pale and old
Linear scar along right temple extending into hairline — security training injury, precise suture work
Faded corporate security tattoo on left shoulder blade — a symbol he no longer acknowledges
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Synthetic muscle fiber replacement visible in both legs below the knee — matte gunmetal finish with faint seam lines along the calf. The prosthetics are functional, not cosmetic. Discrete chrome bezels around ears marking cyberear housing — partially obscured by hair. Wrist has a faint industrial port scar where old gear was interfaced.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually coiled — standing weight forward on the balls of feet. Movement is economical and sudden; he does not amble. Hands rarely still, often checking cuffs, adjusting jacket, touching the chrome at his ears. Eyes constantly tracking exits, angles, sight lines. Conversation posture is slightly angled — cyberears allow him to monitor peripheral audio.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian — durable synthweave in dark colors (charcoal, black, deep navy). Multi-pocket cargo jacket worn open over fitted base layers. Reinforced knuckle gloves, often not removed indoors. Durable boots with high ankle support rated for urban infiltration. A single piece of visible hardware: brushed steel chain on left wrist, practical rather than decorative. Everything functional, nothing that announces itself. No corporate logos or runner affectations — he dresses like someone whose appearance should be forgotten in two minutes.
